browser_interactions.methodology: Real GUI pointer/wheel/click events with document-thread CDP dispatch spans and sampled CPU profiles. Each window records its original process/thread; ambiguous or missing marks fail instead of producing empty measurements. Worker callbacks are excluded from UI-thread stages. Input-to-two-rAF is a presentation proxy, not measured physical presentation or INP. Nested trace spans overlap and must not be summed as exclusive CPU time. Profiling and automation add overhead; one controlled desktop run is not a field percentile.

summary.scope: Five complete navigations in one fresh browser context, native host/project/OS caches retained. First and persisted geometry hits are labelled by the actual DOM attribute; older clients report null. Attached/two-rAF are navigation-relative DOM/frame proxies, not physical first paint. CPU sampling and automation add overhead. Inventory transfer, JSON parsing, input construction, layout/decoding and initial rendering are included, unlike the prepared-geometry overlay unit benchmark. No file inspection, compilation request or model inference is sent.

limits: Browser dispatch is synchronous inclusive work; two-rAF is a proxy rather than physical presentation or field INP. Two drill wheels and one Fit View are maxima/individual observations, not field percentiles.

Static responses are substituted in the automated browser for comparison; native API, response security headers, source/cache checks and original project data remain actual. Routing/tracing/sampling add overhead.
Algorithm timings exclude browser drawing and native preparation. Actual-data matrices use explicit fixed cameras and navigation overlays; performance ratios do not imply equal end-to-end speedups.
Startup captures use static routing with browser HTTP caching affected by interception. Native/project/OS caches remain; actual DOM attributes identify persisted geometry reuse.
Native current-thread CPU excludes children and nested spans overlap. Bounded span eviction is retained per capture.
Generated/test/installed-tool results are not new Lean refinement, cold installation, live-model quality or local large-model deployment.
Source compilation, counterexample and reading caches remain exact; the complete-input preparation wait and remaining generic backend/job/session/retirement work remain open.
